note: Alberta Parks PRA 23 km SE of Hinton on the Robb Road (an active logging haul road), run by the Fox Creek Development Association for West Fraser. Treed sites in a North Loop and a South Loop either side of the Robb Road bridge over the McLeod River, near the Gregg/McLeod confluence; free firewood. --Claude
